series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

groups.reason: Introduces suffix 中 against 最中; no form taught only in another group is produced.
うちに against 間に; both forms are named in the instruction.
Conversion to ている＋最中 or た＋とたん; uses ordinary て-/た-forms only.
Conversion to ます-stem＋次第 or た＋とたん, plus three-way selections among 次第, とたんに and と同時に; ordinary verb forms only.
Conversion to て＋初めて or た＋上で; ordinary verb forms only.
Plain nonpast/negative or past before a printed ことがある／ことがありますか; ordinary verb forms only.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after two rounds; no new findings

findings.claim: と同時に was described as following only the dictionary form.
findings.change: Described as Vる／Vた＋と同時に; 卒業したと同時に and kana variants accepted; rationales and the §5 table updated.

findings.claim: The ちゅう／じゅう reading guidance was inaccurate.
findings.change: Table split: ちゅう for status, period and deadline; じゅう 'throughout'; 今日中 glossed きょうじゅう (also きょうちゅう).

findings.claim: The て初めて rationale misdescribed the construction.
findings.change: Rationale now says て初めて presents a realisation or change that came about only after the experience, whereas comparing prices is a deliberate prior step.

findings.location: とたん and と同時に items, article §5
findings.claim: 次第 rationales claimed it is never used for past events or unplanned outcomes without qualification.
findings.change: Every 次第 contrast now says 'in the as-soon-as sense'; categorical past-event claims removed; rationales name the context.
findings.disposition: resolved in round 2 (leftovers in happy-and-lonely and doctor-novelist fixed)

findings.claim: 'Neither planned nor in the future' overgeneralised.

findings.change: Rationale now says the suffix 中 does not follow a ている clause.

findings.claim: The 'unknown end point' rule did not reliably exclude 間に.
findings.change: Item redesigned as uchi-before-dark on the ない＋うちに frame (暗くならない____、山を下りよう); 'known limits' claims removed everywhere; a stale ないうちに sentence in the article was also corrected.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after two rounds; no new findings

findings.claim: 間に was also acceptable; the context did not decide うちに.
findings.change: Replaced by uchi-old-computer, then by uchi-before-dark (ID and exampleKey changed; key, level, group and facet unchanged).

findings.claim: Three-way 次第／とたんに／と同時に items were not decided safely.
findings.change: Both items print the ます-stem, which excludes と同時に and たとたん by form; と同時に offered on 6 items and keyed on 4; the residual cue that とたん is never keyed in a three-way item is documented as a known doubt.
でき次第, できしだい, 出来次第 and 出来しだい accepted.

findings.claim: Option order put the answer first too often.
findings.change: Options sorted by the relationship's construction order; the answer comes first in 21 of 43 items.
